held.title: Names moved out of mark_failed with no re-export can break existing importers
held.body: `mark_failed_threshold`, `create_issue_platform_occurrence`, `get_failure_reason`, `get_monitor_environment_context` and `SimpleCheckIn` are removed from `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed`. Two of them are also renamed: `mark_failed_threshold` becomes `try_incident_threshold` and `create_issue_platform_occurrence` becomes `create_incident_occurrence`. Any module or test that still imports these names from `mark_failed`, or patches them there with `mock.patch("sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed....")`, will raise ImportError or AttributeError. Tests of `get_failure_reason` are a likely example. I can't see the rest of the repo, so I couldn't check whether those callers were updated. Update every importer and patch target to the new modules, or re-export the old names from `mark_failed` for now.
